prompt.alinti: Ever wonder if your phone is being watched? There's a powerful tool on GitHub with 13,348 stars that helps experts figure that out. It's called the Mobile Verification Toolkit, and it basically acts like a digital detective for your smartphone. You see, when professional hackers try to break into a device, they often leave behind tiny, invisible breadcrumbs in the system files. This software automatically scans through those files to hunt for those specific clues and signs of an unwanted guest. Think of it like using a metal detector on a beach. It doesn't just look for anything, but specifically hunts for the buried objects that shouldn't be there. It was built by experts to help protect people who might be targeted by expensive, high-end spyware. It's definitely a serious tool meant for investigators, so you shouldn't use it for personal troubleshooting. But it's fascinating to see how they catch these invisible intruders. Check out the project page on GitHub.

yontem.ne: Android ve iOS cihazlarında potansiyel ihlal izlerini tespit etmek için kullanılan forensik araçlar koleksiyonu.
yontem.alinti: MobileVerification Toolkit (MVT) is a collection of utilities to simplify and automate the process of gathering forensic traces helpful to identify a potential compromise of Android and iOS devices.

akis.ne: Kullanıcıya MVT'nin amacını ve işleyişini anlatıyor: cihazda gizli izleri tespit eden forensik bir araç olduğunu ve profesyonel hackerlerin bıraktığı 'yemek kırıntıları' (breadcrumbs) gibi izleri taradığını açıklıyor.
akis.alinti: When professional hackers try to break into a device, they often leave behind tiny, invisible breadcrumbs in the system files. This software automatically scans through those files to hunt for those specific clues and signs of an unwanted guest.

akis.ne: MVT'nin Amnesty International Security Lab tarafından Pegasus Projesi kapsamında geliştirildiğini ve sürdürüldüğünü belirtiyor.
akis.alinti: It has been developed and released by the Amnesty International Security Lab in July 2021 in the context of the Pegasus Project.

akis.ne: MVT'nin sadece uzmanlar (forensik araştırmacılar, teknologlar) tarafından kullanılmasını önerdiğini ve kişisel kullanım için uygun olmadığını vurguluyor.
akis.alinti: It's definitely a serious tool meant for investigators, so you shouldn't use it for personal troubleshooting.

akis.ne: Kullanıcıya MVT'nin nasıl çalıştığını ve gizli intruder'ları nasıl tespit ettiğini anlatıyor.
